{{Quote|Though Karness will receive the first, I will complete more than one amulet. The second will go to Dreypa, so those two fools can battle each other unceasingly. The third shall be far stronger than the others, and it shall be mine alone.|[[Sorzus Syn]], extract from [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle of Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="BoS:SftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Syn Talisman''' was a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] the ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] had allegedly intended to create<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /> in the years following the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="JvS:TEGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Similar in form to the [[Muur Talisman]] and [[Dreypa Talisman]], the Syn Talisman was intended to be the most powerful of the [[Great Amulet|three Sith amulets]] created by Syn.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />

Though mentioned in passing in the pages of the [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle of Sorzus Syn]], the details surrounding the Syn Talisman were largely unknown to later generations of Force users, with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] expressing hope that it and other such talismans had not survived the passage of the millennia.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />
